label: Imara
doc: Imara v2 (Electron + Node + SQLite). Database: <home>/.imara/imara.db. Money is cash basis, exactly as Imara's own Dashboard: sales are the payments received on invoices that are not cancelled; expenses are the payments made out.

currency.sql: SELECT value FROM config WHERE key = 'currency'

streams.doc: Each payment received on an invoice. Payments on a cancelled invoice drop out, as they do in Imara.
streams.sql: SELECT CAST(ip.id AS TEXT) AS id, ip.payment_date AS date, ip.created_at AS instant, ip.amount AS amount, NULLIF(TRIM(i.customer_name), '') AS customer, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(ii.description)) = 1 THEN MIN(TRIM(ii.description)) END FROM invoice_items ii WHERE ii.invoice_id = i.id) AS product, i.invoice_number AS m_invoice, ip.payment_method AS m_payment_method FROM invoice_payments ip JOIN invoices i ON i.id = ip.invoice_id WHERE i.status != 'cancelled' ORDER BY CAST(ip.id AS TEXT)

streams.doc: Each payment made out: suppliers, wages, rent, sacks, transport, other.
streams.sql: SELECT CAST(p.id AS TEXT) AS id, p.payment_date AS date, p.created_at AS instant, p.amount AS amount, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.payee_name), '')) AS supplier, p.category AS product, p.rent_month AS m_rent_month FROM payments p LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = p.payee_supplier_id ORDER BY CAST(p.id AS TEXT)
